name: Microservices Architecture
description: Enforce microservices boundaries, independence, and communication patterns

rules.name: No Shared Databases
rules.description: Each service must own its data. No two services should depend on the same database container, as shared databases create tight coupling and make independent deployment impossible.

config.message: Database container has multiple service dependents. Each service must have its own dedicated database.

rules.name: Service Must Have Own Container
rules.description: Each microservice must be modeled as its own container to ensure clear deployment boundaries and independent scalability.

config.message: Every service system must contain at least one container.

rules.name: No Direct DB Calls From API Gateway
rules.description: API gateways must route requests to services, never query databases directly. Direct DB access from the gateway bypasses service logic and breaks encapsulation.

config.message: API gateway must not have direct relationships to database containers. Route through the owning service instead.

rules.name: Inter-Service Communication Via Contracts
rules.description: All synchronous communication between services must be documented with an API contract (OpenAPI, gRPC, GraphQL). Undocumented inter-service calls create hidden coupling.

config.message: Synchronous inter-service relationship must have an associated API contract.

rules.name: Health Check Component Required
rules.description: Each service container must include a health check component for orchestration, load balancing, and observability.

config.message: Service container must include a health check component.

rules.name: Maximum Dependency Depth
rules.description: Dependency chains between services must not exceed 3 hops. Deep chains increase latency, complicate debugging, and create fragile call paths.

config.message: Service dependency chain exceeds 3 levels. Refactor to reduce coupling or introduce async communication.

rules.name: No Circular Dependencies Between Services
rules.description: Circular dependencies between services prevent independent deployment and create deadlock risks. Use events or shared contracts to break cycles.

config.message: Circular dependency detected between services. Break the cycle using event-driven communication or extract shared logic.

rules.name: Independent Deployment Artifact
rules.description: Each service must be independently deployable with its own Dockerfile or equivalent build artifact, ensuring services can be released on their own schedule.

config.message: Service container must have Docker or OCI technology assigned for independent deployment.

rules.name: Service Naming Convention
rules.description: Service names must follow PascalCase convention for consistency across the architecture model and documentation.

config.message: Service name must be PascalCase (e.g., OrderService, PaymentGateway).

rules.name: Documented Inter-Service Relationships
rules.description: All inter-service calls must be modeled as explicit relationships with a description. Undocumented relationships are invisible technical debt.

config.message: Inter-service relationship must have a description explaining the interaction.
